unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፰ — Meraf 8: Grand Master of ዠ and የ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ዠ and የ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የዠ እና የየ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: ZHENTILA
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'ZHENTILA' (Umbrella) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ዠንጥላ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Umbrella' (Zhentila). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]ንጥላ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ዠንጥላ (pronounced Zhen-ti-la).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 2nd form ➔ 4th form ➔ [ ? ] (6th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ዠንጥላ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Umbrella (Zhentila)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first form 'ዠ', followed by 'ን', 'ጥ', and end with 'ላ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: YENE
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'YENE' (Mine) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ይ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the native 6th form 'Y' sound of the የ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: የእጅ ሰዓት
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Wristwatch (Ye'eje Se'at)!

games.title: Grand Decoder: YE'EJE SE'AT
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'YE'EJE SE'AT' (Wristwatch) with the correct Amharic word.
